rules: Normal edit: only the hook changes (sometimes the rehook). Body, end clip, caption style and song placement come from the template.

Hook longer or shorter than the template: the tool ripples the timeline. Body and CTA move, the hook caption stretches, the song starts earlier (music box, handoff fixed) or runs longer (no end sound).
Store-claim hooks (RUN to <STORE>, <BRAND> x <STORE>, '<STORE> just collabed') pair with the reveal CTA (JK / Just JOKING / Je rigole). Every other hook pairs with the plain CTA.
Use the store the hook clip actually shows (TARGET / WALMART / COSTCO / LECLERC / CARREFOUR).
Unboxing / bag-cut hooks (product pulled out of a packet): drop the store checkout clip (spec "drop_clips": ["checkout-pay.mp4"]). Ali 2026-10-09.

Hook clip with its own burned-in caption: no caption of ours over it. Our hook caption starts when the burned-in one disappears, with the SAME text, emojis, size and height (spec "texts" + "text_style": {"hook": {"start": <s>, "y": <y>, "scale_mult": <x>}}). Rare. Ali 2026-10-09.
Caption must not cover the face: if it sits on the eyes, raise it slightly ("text_style": {"hook": {"y_shift": 0.08}}), still below the Instagram top icons. Ali 2026-10-09.
Hook ends max about 1 s after the product display lands (hook_out). Showing the boxes 2-3 s in the hook is too long. Ali 2026-10-09.
workflow: Same as the music box song timelines: each timeline holds its song; picking the song = picking the timeline. Swap the hook (an old hook in pieces is replaced as one) and set the caption. Body (checkout -> install -> chip -> projections) never changes. Door Beam has no raw end sound: one song under the whole video. Its start is synced to the hook, so a longer hook extends the song at the END, never the beginning (Ali, 2026-10-08).
mix: Keep each song timeline exactly as Ali mixed it.
